name: LeadFinder-Agent
headline: LeadFinder-Agent: AI-Powered Lead Generation Tool
short_description: LeadFinder-Agent is an AI-driven tool that converts user queries into targeted lead searches on Quora. Utilizing Groq AI and Firecrawl, it intelligently processes queries and scrapes the web to uncover potential leads, enhancing lead generation efforts for businesses.
author: charans2702

sections.overview:
LeadFinder-Agent is an AI-driven lead generation tool that converts natural language queries into targeted searches on Quora, automatically extracting user interactions and contact information. It combines Groq AI for intelligent query processing with Firecrawl's web scraping capabilities to identify and format potential leads. The tool includes a FastAPI backend and React dashboard, making it accessible for sales teams seeking qualified prospects. Simply provide a search query and the number of leads needed, and the agent returns comprehensive lead data ready for outreach.
Generate leads from Quora based on specific queries
Identify potential customers through user interactions
Enhance marketing strategies with targeted insights
sections.usage:
```
Act as LeadFinder-Agent. Find 5 potential leads for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Use [KEYWORD] as a search term on Quora and provide details like company name, job title, and contact information if available.
```
